sentences.text:
Applicant is in detention since 27.05.2024.
2.
The first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 26.09.2024 passed in MCRC.
No.41678/2024 and second application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 18.12.2024 passed in MCRC 3.
As per the prosecution story, allegation against the applicant is of abducting and committing rape with the minor prosecutrix.
On the basis of which, the offence was registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid Sections.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6333 2 MCRC-3191-2025 4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case.
He is in custody since 27.05.2024.
It is submitted that in MLC, no injuries have been found on the body of the prosecutrix but DNA report is positive which indicates that DNA report is doubtful.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that at the time of incident, age of prosecutrix was below 15 years.
DNA is also positive.

7.
